name: Docker Hub MCP
description: MCP server for searching Docker Hub images, tags, repositories, and Docker Hardened Images.

envVars.description: HTTP MCP port exposed by the server
Optional Docker Hub username for authenticated repository management
Optional Docker Hub personal access token

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{envRaw.DOCKER_HUB_MCP_PORT}}:{{envRaw.DOCKER_HUB_MCP_PORT}}"
    environment:
      HUB_PAT_TOKEN: {{env.HUB_PAT_TOKEN}}
    command: ["--transport=http", "--port={{envRaw.DOCKER_HUB_MCP_PORT}}", "--username={{envRaw.HUB_USERNAME}}"]
